high_level_description: stc brand style, three men sitting together on a couch in a casual living room.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A living room with a light gray circle-patterned wall, a framed display of model vehicles and memorabilia, two white floating shelves with books and a red toy car, warm even lighting, and a TV visible at the bottom of the frame.

elements.desc: A man wearing a yellow t-shirt and black baseball cap, holding a white object, seated on the left.
A man wearing a white traditional garment, hands raised in an animated gesture, seated in the middle.
A man wearing a red and black plaid shirt and glasses, looking down at something in his hands, seated on the right.
A small bowl of snacks and a glass of water on a wooden coffee table in front of the couch.
